items.title: Uncovered and Disrupted BADBOX 3.0, the Largest Ad Fraud Operation by Bid Volume Ever Publicly Disclosed
items.content: BADBOX 3.0 represents the largest ad fraud operation ever disclosed, generating approximately 40 billion bid requests daily and comprising over 4% of all connected TV traffic. The operation primarily targets low-cost consumer devices infected with backdoors delivering fraud modules linked to TXCZ, a Chinese electronics manufacturer. items.title: Device Code Phishing in Microsoft 365: Attack Analysis
items.content: In November 2026, a resurgence of device-code phishing campaigns targeted Microsoft 365 accounts using payment-themed emails and fake SharePoint workspaces. items.title: UAT-12643: Suspected North Korea-aligned actor blends blockchain resilience with targeted infostealing

items.title: N0N Ransomware Group: Victims, Leak Site, TTPs & IOCs
items.content: N0N is a financially motivated cyber extortion group that emerged in September 2026, employing data theft and extortion tactics without using traditional encryption methods.
